messages:
Priya: Noticing a spike of 'INVOICE_IMPORT_FAILED' alerts this morning. About 14 invoices in the overnight job failed NetSuite import with "INV_XML_SCHEMA_ERROR". Anyone see this from export side?

billing-bot: nightly-export-job failed: 01:08 UTC - netsuite_api 400 "INV_XML_SCHEMA_ERROR" (job id: ne-2026-05-01-01)

Owen: I pulled one of the raw export blobs: the XML for invoice inv_Zq9 has an extra empty <taxRate/> element per line. NetSuite rejects empty tag. Example snippet: 

```xml
<line>
  <description>usage</description>
  <amount>42.00</amount>
  <taxRate/>
</line>
```

Nina: That matches an earlier change in export-serializer where we attempted to always emit taxRate tag for schema completeness. The serializer logic wrote an empty element when tax_rate is null instead of omitting the node.

Priya: Finance put the 14 invoices on hold. If NetSuite rejects them we risk missed revenue recognition and collections flow. Can we hotfix quickly?

Owen: Patch ready: change serializer to omit taxRate tag when null. Adding unit test to ensure elements are only present when value defined. I'll push to canary now.

qa-bot: export-serializer-canary run: 60 sample invoice serializations, 0 instances of empty tags found.

Nina: Also need to check our XML sanitizer that signs and timestamps payloads. If we re-emit fixed XML, NetSuite may consider them duplicates (it uses a hash). Best approach: re-run import with corrected XML but include header `X-Reemit-Reason: schema_fix` so NetSuite admin can map.

Priya: Created TICKET-4401: "Empty taxRate element causing NetSuite INV_XML_SCHEMA_ERROR - backfill & re-import". Accounting: can you hold reversing actions until we re-import? We don't want duplicate credit memos.

accounting: We'll hold automated reversal templates. If NetSuite shows partial imports, we'll review on a case-by-case basis. Send list of affected invoice ids.

Owen: Quarantined the 14 export messages to export-fix-quarantine-2026-05-01. Patch deployed to canary. If canary metrics look good, we'll deploy to prod during a short window and re-emit quarantine after sign-off.

Priya: Please attach canary logs to TICKET-4401. Finance will review and approve re-emits once ops confirms idempotency behavior. Also notify CS if any customers ask about invoice delays.

Nina: Follow-ups: 1) add serializer rule to never emit empty XML nodes, 2) add a CI lint that scans generated XML for empty tags, 3) update runbook: on INV_XML_SCHEMA_ERROR, quarantine exports and notify finance immediately.

Owen: Will run re-emits only after accounting confirms hold is in place. Planning a 30min maintenance window to deploy fix and re-run quarantined messages.

Priya: Thanks all. Posting the list of 14 invoice ids to TICKET-4401 now. If anyone sees customer escalations, @Priya is the contact.

billing-bot: messages moved to quarantine queue: export-fix-quarantine-2026-05-01 (14 messages).
